texts: Whenever a sky-cat hunts on the Cliff Path, each nightmoth that survives the hunt flees to the Hollows.
When a sky-cat hunts on the Cliff Path, the Hollows lanterns gain nightmoths.
The displaced nightmoths keep the Hollows lanterns productive.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts on the Cliff Path, each nightmoth that survives the hunt flees to the Hollows.
parse: (: whenever_hunt_flee (Implication (And (Member $h hunt) (Agent $h $c) (Member $c sky_cat) (Location $h cliff_path) (Member $m nightmoth) (Member $sv survive) (Agent $sv $m) (Theme $sv $h)) (And (Member (sk_flee $m $h) flee) (Agent (sk_flee $m $h) $m) (Goal (sk_flee $m $h) hollows) (During (sk_flee $m $h) $h))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-machinery applied correctly: indefinite trigger participants as plain premise variables, the restrictive relative clause as a premise conjunct, "the hunt" resolved to the trigger event variable, the response a Skolem function of both scoping universals with the During link, "each" recorded as a QuantifierPhrase companion while "whenever" correctly takes none. "Cliff Path" gets its name-internal kind atom and the capitalized plural "the Hollows" correctly gets Name only.

fields.sentence: When a sky-cat hunts on the Cliff Path, the Hollows lanterns gain nightmoths.
parse: (: e1_whenever (Implication (And (Member $x hunt) (Agent $x $c) (Member $c sky_cat) (Location $x cliff_path)) (And (Member (sk_gain $x) gain) (Agent (sk_gain $x) sk_lantern_1) (Theme (sk_gain $x) nightmoth) (During (sk_gain $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a definite-plural group subject carrying a distributive predicate ('the Hollows lanterns gain nightmoths') inside a whenever-rule CONCLUSION: the plural doctrine mandates a per-member distribution rule over (PartOf $x <group>) beside the group event, but the instruction set gives no shape for nesting such a rule inside a rule consequent, so the distribution is simply absent

a bare-plural object inside a per-occurrence rule conclusion ('gain nightmoths') — the episodic-clause rule mints a group witness and the kind-level rule keeps a bare kind filler, but a rule consequent is neither, so which applies is unstated
review.notes: Routing, rule shape, Skolem-function event, During link, proper-noun premodifier (Possession on the lantern group + Name hollows), Cliff Path name+kind atom, and both compound genus atoms all follow the instruction set as written.

fields.sentence: The displaced nightmoths keep the Hollows lanterns productive.

q2_gaps: solid/closed compound spelling ('nightmoths'): the instruction set mandates that such a form still decomposes and emits its head genus, but never fixes whether the emitted compound symbol keeps the solid spelling (nightmoth) or is split (night_moth)
review.notes: Maintenance resultative is exactly per doctrine (Theme object, reified productive state with Still, Result link) and the plural-object flat half is correctly replaced by the PartOf distribution rule at 1.0/0.9. Proper-noun premodifier 'Hollows' correctly takes head-noun typing plus opaque Possession and a Name atom with no invented kind.
